k-nvidia.title: Nvidia earnings and CEO scandal coins
k-nvidia.sourceSays: Posts say Nvidia is down sharply amid Jensen Huang scandals and reported $115.8B quarterly revenue on Nov 17; shill posts push the Nvidia Inu $NI coin as riding that narrative.
k-nvidia.reason: Posts of Nov 17 discuss Nvidia's drawdown, the Huang scandals and the earnings print; the coins opened hours ago. Coin-specific posts are shills, so the link to the coins is only claimed.
